propositions: Dependabot PR #131 proposes bumping five packages (botocore, genai-prices, json-repair, mypy, ruff) but cannot merge directly to GitHub; the change must be re-authored through Gerrit and landed to main for auto-closure.

The uv.lock resolver produces newer patch versions (botocore 1.43.75, genai-prices 0.1.4, json-repair 0.63.3) than the PR originally proposed, and these current resolutions must be used to avoid fighting dependabot with stale pins.

Bumping mypy and ruff (the typecheck and lint gates) requires verification that no new findings surface and that the complexity ratchet remains shrink-only; any new violations must be fixed in code, not suppressed with directives.
The landed Gerrit change 1943 (merged commit dab851c5fb) passes all lint, typecheck, and test gates with zero new source changes, and the complexity baseline remains unmodified.
PR #131 auto-closed after the Gerrit merge propagated to the GitHub mirror, with dependabot confirming no further updates available.
